sloka: ते विद्धा हरयस्तत्र नास्खलन्नापि बभ्रमुः ।बभूवुः स्वस्थहृदयाः पद्मनालैरिवाहताः ।। ६.१०९.१५ ।।
transliteration: te viddhā harayastatra nāskhalannāpi babhramuḥ ।babhūvuḥ svasthahṛdayāḥ padmanālairivāhatāḥ ।। 6.109.15 ।।

translations.english: Ravana with his burning arrows pierced Rama's horses. Those horses were wonderful as they did not stagger or reel as if hurt by lotus stalks and remained complacent.
